scripts/build-smto-site-social.py

Python · Tier B

Render the typographic share card with test-only Chromium and no remote assets.

Usage

.venv/bin/python scripts/build-smto-site-social.py

Inputs

The source-owned HTML/CSS card below and locally installed Chromium.

Side effects

Writes src/smto_site/static/social.png; does not publish or contact services.

Cleanup

Closes Chromium before returning; the generated graphic remains on disk. This is a build-time HTML/CSS graphic, not runtime UI or a screenshot of a run.

@see src/smto_site/templates/base.html
